title: Rhino connector how-to verification record
description: One line per (document id, script hash, Rhino version) in corpus/verified.jsonl. Written ONLY by the harness sweep (or, weaker, by a session that ran the exact script). Merged with the corpus at index time; a stamp whose script_sha256 no longer matches the document's script is stale and ignored.

script_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact script text that ran; the binding between a stamp and a document version.

by.description: harness: the repo's tier-2 sweep. session: a session ran this exact script successfully; weaker, and shown as such.

connector_version.description: The broker's -version line at the time of the run.

diagnostic.description: For failed: the diagnostic message the run produced. Required when status is failed.

rev.description: The document revision whose script this stamp verified; with script_sha256, the binding between a stamp and one revision.
